scope: structuredContent of the native unified MCP query result

fields.name: dataset
fields.meaning: Dataset code identifying the queried dataset.
fields.type_note: The exact native type is not re-verified by this fixture.

fields.name: columns
fields.meaning: Actual field names, display labels and column types. Detail description must use actual field names, not aliases or labels.

fields.name: data
fields.shape: positional matrix: list of rows, each row a list of cell values
fields.meaning: Cell values are aligned by column position. The fixture does not assume object-shaped rows.

fields.name: rows
fields.meaning: Page size, not the number of returned rows. A short last page keeps the requested page size here.

fields.name: page
fields.meaning: Page selector. The fixture uses a 1-based synthetic hypothesis; the observation does not prove the native origin.

fields.name: has_more
fields.meaning: Whether a further page exists for the same query.

fields.name: total
fields.meaning: Optional count of output rows or groups, not an aggregate cell value. Absence means unknown, never zero.

semantic_constraints_observed: describe performs keyword/kind dataset search; detail is requested only by exact code and reports actual field names.
query selects verified fields; '*' is used only for count.
filters and sort use only published fields and published operations.
include_total may count records or groups.
Known safe ungrouped aggregates are COUNT and COUNT DISTINCT with explicit aliases.
Actual grouped aggregate and pagination completeness require separate contract proof.
A valid zero differs from empty, missing, denied and failed.
explicit_non_claims: The native request/input schema is not observed and is not inferred here.
The native type vocabulary is not proven; the fixture uses host-aligned string/number/boolean labels.
The page-index origin is not proven; 1-based indexing is a labelled fixture hypothesis.
The native error envelope shape is not observed; error cases use normalized outcome classes.
The native describe reply shape is not observed; describe cases use normalized semantic observations.
Grouped aggregate values, sums and pagination completeness are arithmetic ground truth only, not product support.
No customer dataset code, field, row, answer or identifier is used.
